limitations: Current-survivor proxy universe; not a point-in-time ETF universe.
Yahoo auto-adjusted prices are a total-return proxy, not issuer NAV authority.
Macro and event snapshots are prospective context only; holdings, futures-curve, FX and tax inputs are absent.

methodology.curve: month-end historical observations in the same 10-point opportunity-score band
methodology.downside_risk: positioning-unwind watch requires prior 58-session gain >=15%, 5-session loss >=6%, relative loss versus SPY >=4%, and 21-session drawdown >=9%; only a material negative event upgrades it to downside bias
methodology.final_score: price score plus bounded fresh catalysts, decaying persistent sentiment, historical analogs, risk, and state-transition inputs; repeated coverage cannot multiply one theme
methodology.opportunity: 75% cross-sectional 21/63/126-session total-return momentum rank + 25% positive-trend confirmation
methodology.risk: equal-weight cross-sectional 63-session volatility and 126-session drawdown ranks

ECONOMIC_GROWTH.rationale: Selected authoritative macro state changes: strong US jobs report raising Fed-hike odds, Canada job loss/unemployment uptick, Norway highest unemployment since WWII, Indonesia GDP, Ethiopia GDP rebasing to fifth-largest Africa economy, Senegal growth slowdown, Philippines GDP revision/manufacturing, Bulgaria unemployment; local county and op-ed items excluded.

ENERGY_SUPPLY.rationale: Selected verified supply/price state changes: large oil selloff on Iran-war de-escalation hopes (multiple corroborations), IEA Hormuz gas-tightening warning, OPEC+ holding targets, Houthi strike on Saudi oil facilities, EIA Venezuela import data, tanker-attack price surge, Iran-oil sanctions, and a new Vietnam discovery; retail gasoline puffery excluded.

FINANCIAL_STRESS.rationale: Fewer than eight distinct systemic-stress events; included French bond-spread/post-crisis interest bill, record private-credit default jump, Greek bank NPL/cyber alert, US credit-card delinquency rise, and Trinidad household-debt stability risk; personal-finance and local items excluded.

HEALTH_POLICY.rationale: Selected verified policy/regulatory state changes: multistate AG suit over Medicaid work requirements, Nebraska hospital push to reverse cuts, Medicare remote-monitoring delay, Medicare Part D 50% cost jump, J&J bispecific FDA approval, second generic venetoclax approval, India cancer-drug price cuts, and Georgia Medicaid expansion plan; stock picks and consumer advice excluded.

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: Ranked by verified state changes (US strikes on Iran air defenses near Hormuz, Iran lifting missile-range limit, Russia strikes on Kyiv, US firing on commercial vessel) with highest global transmission via energy/shipping and multiple corroborating reports; local crime and political-attack items excluded.

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: Selected verifiable central-bank/inflation state changes: ECB December hike 'nearly inevitable', Fed officials favoring more hikes, Thailand 45-month-high inflation, Norway krone slump on inflation surprise, BOJ 2% target, Ghana inflation print, PBOC cash-injection shift, and central-bank gold buying rebound; previews and op-eds excluded.

POLITICAL_SOCIAL_SHOCK.rationale: Selected verified political/geopolitical and disaster state changes: Israel president tapping Eisenkot, US Senate shutdown deal, Nasdaq rout on AI concerns, Gaza winter-storm flooding of 70k tents, Japan earthquake injuring 22, Tennessee/Georgia 1-in-1000-year flood emergency, Colombo flood task force, and California insurance-commissioner election with wildfire overhaul; NZ election pieces and sports/celebrity items excluded.

PRECIOUS_METALS.rationale: Selected verifiable gold/silver market state changes: Goldman cutting gold target as debasement trade fades, central-bank buying up 42% with ETF inflows, Ghana gold paper-loss clarification, an output-withholding top producer, Dhanteras gold sales surge, Pakistan/domestic gold price prints, and miner earnings/price-target moves; sports medals and 'Silver' place names excluded.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: Selected verified corporate/policy state changes: AMD's $2.9B Taalas acquisition, Alphabet's $15B Malaysia data-center investment, 44-1 voter data-center rejections, chip-market selloff tied to AI-skeptical midterm sweep, US-approved Nvidia sales to China-linked firms, semiconductor labor-shortage training push, federal data-center energy scrutiny, and AI ETF decline; stock-picking and local zoning items excluded.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: Selected material trade-policy state changes: Trump floating 300% tariffs post-midterms, EU defending Airbus tariffs, Walmart warning on lamb tariffs, China tariff relief extension to 2028, zero-tariff Africa avocado surge, Canada tariff-aid budget, EU climate tax trade-war risk with India, Russian trade restrictions shifting Armenia exports; US election opinion pieces and local electricity-tariff items excluded.
